hero.title: Simplicity and Control Combined:
hero.subtitle: A clean, lightweight Minecraft launcher featuring Modrinth & CurseForge integration, package builder, and custom themes.

features.title: INVIS Launcher Features
features.subtitle: Designed to manage your Minecraft modpacks easily without any bloatware.
features.card1Desc: Engineered to launch quickly with minimal memory footprint and zero background bloat.
features.card2Desc: Browse, search, and manage hundreds of mods, shaders, and resource packs directly inside the client.
features.card3Desc: Configure your Minecraft version, Vanilla or Fabric loader, and RAM memory limit in seconds.
features.card4Desc: Seamlessly switch between Dark, Light, OLED, and System default visual themes.
features.card5Desc: No annoying ads or popups. Just pure Minecraft gameplay focus.
features.card6Desc: Easily toggle, remove, or configure your mods, shaders, and Java runtime paths.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about INVIS Launcher.
faq.a1: Yes, INVIS Launcher is 100% free and contains zero advertisements.
faq.a2: Clicking download takes you directly to the official GitHub Releases page where you can download the latest installer.
faq.q3: How do I add mods and shaders?
faq.a3: Use the 'Explore' tab in the launcher to browse Modrinth & CurseForge mods, and manage them inside the 'Files' tab.
faq.a4: Yes! You can choose between Dark, Light, OLED, and System Match themes in Settings.
faq.a5: The launcher auto-detects installed Java paths on your PC and allows custom path configuration in Settings.

legal.privacyP1: At INVIS Launcher, we prioritize user privacy and data security above all else. This Privacy Policy outlines how user data is handled when using the INVIS Launcher software and website.
legal.privacyP2: INVIS Launcher does NOT collect personal identification information, passwords, browsing history, or keystrokes. Our software is entirely ad-free and contains no user tracking.
legal.privacyP3: Your game profiles, preferred theme settings (Dark, Light, OLED), Minecraft versions, mod lists, and Java runtime paths are stored locally and securely on your PC.
legal.privacyP4: When browsing mods in the 'Explore' tab, data is queried directly from official Modrinth and CurseForge APIs. No personal identification is transmitted during these requests.
legal.privacyP5: INVIS Launcher releases and binaries are hosted directly on our open-source GitHub repository (INVISLauncher/invislauncher).
legal.termsP1: These Terms of Service govern your use of the INVIS Launcher software and website. By downloading or using the software, you agree to these terms.
legal.termsP2: INVIS Launcher is a free, independent client designed to help gamers manage Minecraft versions, mods, and packages. The software is provided free of charge for personal use.
legal.termsP3: Users must not utilize the client to bypass server security or distribute harmful content. Compliance with multiplayer server rules is the sole responsibility of the user.
legal.termsP4: Mods, shaders, and resource packs downloaded via INVIS Launcher belong to their respective creators. INVIS Launcher is not responsible for game crashes caused by third-party mods.
legal.termsP5: The software is provided 'AS IS' without warranty of any kind. The development team is not liable for data loss or game file corruption resulting from third-party mod usage.
